values.note: Approximate: DCNR says late March to mid-December.

season.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/pine-grove-furnace-state-park/stay ('Seventy tent and trailer sites are available from late March to mid-December'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Only site 039 (Horseshoe Loop) lists 50-amp; the other 45 electric sites list 30-amp. No site lists water or sewer hookups.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880310 (46 public Modern Electric sites: 1 lists 50-amp, 45 list 30-amp), https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/pine-grove-furnace-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880310, read 2026-10-20

values.note: 68 campsites on the booking site (46 Modern Electric, the rest non-electric and tent-only) besides the Paymaster's Cabin and six organized group tenting sites; DCNR says seventy tent and trailer sites. Listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 40-60 ft (site 071 is 68 ft), a few 10-30 ft; two are pull-through (016, 067).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/pine-grove-furnace-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880310 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: A seasonal camp store is one quarter-mile from the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/pine-grove-furnace-state-park/stay ('A sanitary dump station is near the campground entrance', 'A seasonal camp store is one quarter-mile from the campground') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880310 (Bath House, Showers, Sanitation Dumping Station Is Available In The Campground), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/pine-grove-furnace-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880310 (Booking Window for Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric, Modern Tent Only: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park. Added the season (late March to mid-December; the entry had none), electric (one 50-amp site, the rest 30-amp), 68 campsites to ~60 ft with two pull-throughs, showers and dump station. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
